annotations.title: Check a trading signal in the sandbox

description: Check one trading signal before you publish it (POST /signals/sandbox/check). Free, no key, nothing stored, nothing placed; limited to 30 calls a minute per caller. Pass profile (your strategy profile: type, universe, limits, order_types, cadence, stop_policy; see signal_standard) and message (an nwsp/1 message, or an nwsp/0 teaching-format message, which needs no profile), plus optional previous_book ({seq, positions[]}; for nwsp/0 your previous message), follower_fund_usd (default 3000) and follower_caps ({max_leverage, max_position_leverage, max_order_usd, allowed_assets, holdings}). Returns {ok, read_as (how it was read, in plain lines), errors[{path, code, message, fix}], warnings, normalized, reference_orders (on 10,000 USDC: side, order type, price, size in coins, reduce-only, attached stop and take-profit), follower_view {fund, orders, skipped (each with a reason and a sentence), unchanged}, book_after, book_hash (send it as book_hash_after), cost_estimate (Hyperliquid taker by dex, Torii fee on opening orders, an assumed slippage; the assumptions are in the answer), prices}. Live prices are one Hyperliquid read; if it fails, prices is null and the price-band check is skipped with a warning.

follower_caps.description: Optional: the follower's caps {max_leverage, max_position_leverage, max_order_usd, allowed_assets[], holdings{asset: usdc}}

follower_fund_usd.description: Optional: a follower fund in USDC (default 3000)

message.description: The signal message (protocol nwsp/1, or v nwsp/0)

previous_book.description: Optional: the book before this message {seq, positions[{asset, side, notional_pct_ref}], resting[]}; for nwsp/0 the previous message

profile.description: Your strategy profile (not needed for an nwsp/0 message)

name: signal_sandbox_check
title: Check a trading signal in the sandbox
